mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 51 degrees and overcast at Badger Prairie County Park. We are under a third quarter moon, and although the ISS passes overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city reminds you that winter street parking regulations begin November 20 through April 1, requiring you to park on alternating sides of the street overnight. Also, the Water Utility is partnering with agencies to conduct important cross-connection control inspections, so please watch your mail for a request to schedule an appointment.

Today is packed with local music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market. Looking ahead, you can join trivia nights at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's starting on November 4.
In a recent report, officers noted that on October 25, a 40-year-old man was arrested for his first offence of O W I after being found stopped in an intersection.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 11:00 PM tonight.
